What changed

The काम की स्थिति card was rebuilt around the ACS Stage-1 ordering gates, and a full in-app NetBox ordering flow was added. Highlights:

+5 Stage-1 gate states (ordering switch, quality, at-risk, enforcement, prior receipt) RED "काम बंद है" tag for all stopped states NEW at-risk + order combined state NEW order screen with ×5 stepper + eligibility heading NEW NetBox-credit हिसाब breakup + info sheet NEW minimum ₹1,000 top-up with credit-conversion transparency NEW payment-confirm popup → success → order tracker

AUTHORIZED

Eligible — work continues

The happy path. Quality is good and there's demand in the area, so new connections keep coming automatically. No action needed.

Copy refreshed
काम जोखिम में है
AT_RISK

At risk — advisory

Quality is near the minimum but still passes the ordering gate, so the CSP orders the full amount. An amber advisory nudges them to keep quality up. Not a block.

New stateNew tag & copy
काम जोखिम में है
AT_RISK_ORDER

At risk + order required

At risk AND short of boxes. The ask shifts to ordering (that unblocks new work), while quality stays a caution folded into the subtext. CTA → order screen.

New combined state

Gate 1 — Ordering paused (Wiom)

Wiom has manually paused ordering for this CSP. Not self-serviceable — the CTA routes to support. Red tag: work is stopped.

New Stage-1 gateTag → RED

Gate 2 — Quality non-compliant

Only NON_COMPLIANT quality hard-blocks. New connections resume automatically once quality recovers. CTA cross-links to Seva Sthiti.

Tag → REDCopy refreshed

ENFORCEMENT

Gate 3 — Enforcement

An administrative restriction (penalty) is on the account. Split out from the old blanket 'blocked' state. CTA routes to support.

New Stage-1 gateTag → RED
ऑर्डर पेंडिंग है
PRIOR_RECEIPT

Gate 4 — Prior receipt pending

One order at a time. A previous NetBox order is still in progress; a new one can be placed only after it's received. CTA → order tracker.

New Stage-1 gate
काम कम है
FROZEN_DEMAND

Gate 5 — Capacity [FUTURE]

Low demand in the area right now — not the CSP's fault. Marked [FUTURE]: it never blocks ordering until zones are calibrated. Neutral styling, no CTA.

Gated as FUTURE

ROUTER_NOT_AVAILABLE

Eligible — short of boxes

All gates pass and the deposit covers the batch; the CSP simply has no idle boxes. Nothing to pay — Wiom ships them. Green pill; CTA opens the order screen.

Reachable nowPill → GREEN
काम रुका हुआ
MAX_CAPACITY

Max NetBox limit reached

A hard ceiling on total devices held. Can't order more regardless of funds; CTA routes to support.

Copy refreshed
Order flow

Order screen — covered

Heading shows total eligibility (up to 10). A ×5 stepper picks the quantity. The हिसाब breakup shows order (5) vs credit (7): the credits cover it, so कुल पेमेंट is ₹0 (green).

New screen×5 stepperहिसाब breakup
Order flow

Credit info sheet

A small ⓘ beside 'नेटबॉक्स क्रेडिट' opens this sheet: 1 credit = ₹200 = 1 NetBox, each ₹200 top-up adds a credit, and unused credits stay for the next order.

New info sheet
Order flow

Order screen — top-up

Stepping to 10 leaves the CSP short 3 credits. The transparency line states the ₹1,000 top-up gives 5 credits — 3 for this order, 2 saved for next — so the money isn't lost. कुल पेमेंट ₹1,000.

Top-up mathCredit transparency
Order flow

Payment confirm popup

Confirms the deduction before placing: wallet balance (₹40,000), the amount deducting (−₹1,000), and the balance after (₹39,000). Blocks confirm if the wallet can't cover it.

New payment popup
Order flow

Order placed — success

After payment, a success state confirms the order and points to the tracker. 'ऑर्डर देखें' navigates to NetBox Home where the order tracker shows.

New success state
